Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Interface PluginContext

public interface PluginContext
Plugin-scoped SDK context supplied during TurboismPlugin.init(PluginContext).

Use only these SDK services; plugins must not depend on runtime implementation classes, com.live2d.*, reflection, raw host objects, native handles, or host widgets. Context services and objects can be invalidated by plugin disable, document lifecycle changes, provider replacement, and unsupported-host transitions. Default methods that throw indicate that an optional service is absent in this compatibility context; methods returning an unavailable service provide typed unavailable results instead.
